judged_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/decodeOAuthState.ts:9 — [P1, confidence 75] `const state: IntegrationOAuthCallbackState = JSON.parse(req.query.state);` accepts attacker-selected state without a session-bound nonce check, allowing an attacker to send their unused OAuth authorization code to a logged-in victim through the HubSpot callback and attach the attacker-controlled integration to the victim account.

adjudication.rationale: The finding claims there's a CSRF vulnerability in decodeOAuthState.ts due to missing nonce check. However, looking at the diff, this file was simply moved/renamed from packages/app-store/_utils/decodeOAuthState.ts to packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/decodeOAuthState.ts with only import path changes. The actual logic (JSON.parse of state) existed before this diff and was not introduced by it. The diff shows no changes to the security logic of OAuth state handling - it's purely a file reorganization. The finding incorrectly attributes a pre-existing design pattern to this diff.
